text_en: Send out your bread upon the waters, for after many days you will get it back.
text_cn: 把你的粮食抛到水面，多日后你必有所获。

text_en: Divide your means seven ways, or even eight, for you do not know what disaster may happen on earth.
text_cn: 将你的家产分作七分八分，因为你不知道世上要发生什么灾祸。

text_en: When clouds are full, they empty rain on the earth; whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where the tree falls, there it will lie.
text_cn: 云一满了，雨即倾注于地。树倒向南或倒向北，一倒在哪里，就躺在哪里。

text_en: Whoever observes the wind will not sow; and whoever regards the clouds will not reap.
text_cn: 观察风向的，必不撒种；研究云象的，必不收割，

text_en: Just as you do not know how the breath comes to the bones in the mother’s womb, so you do not know the work of God, who makes everything.
text_cn: 就如你不知道生气如何进入孕妇胎中的骨骼里，同样你也不知道天主所创造的一切化工。

text_en: In the morning sow your seed, and at evening do not let your hands be idle; for you do not know which will prosper, this or that, or whether both alike will be good.
text_cn: 你早上撒种，晚上也不要住手，因为你不知道：是早上撒的，或是晚上撒的长的好，或是两种都同样好。

text_en: Light is sweet, and it is pleasant for the eyes to see the sun.
text_cn: 光明实在可爱，看见太阳实在令眼舒畅。

text_en: Even those who live many years should rejoice in them all; yet let them remember that the days of darkness will be many. All that comes is vanity.
text_cn: 人无论活了多大年纪，尽可享受各种福乐；但他应想到黑暗的日子还多，所发生的事，尽属虚幻。

text_en: Rejoice, young man, while you are young, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth. Follow the inclination of your heart and the desire of your eyes, but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
text_cn: 少年人，在你青春时应欢乐；在你少壮的时日，应心神愉快；随你心所欲，你眼所悦的去行，但应知道：天主必要就你所行的一切审判你。

text_en: Banish anxiety from your mind, and put away pain from your body; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
text_cn: 扫除你心中的烦恼，驱除你身上的痛苦，因为青春和少年都是虚幻。
